# Coding AI Prompt — Athletics-Themed Landing Page

## 1. Role & Objective
You are a senior front-end engineer. Build a complete, production-ready landing page themed **"Athletics"** (a gallery-grade, monograph-on-black-velvet editorial aesthetic). Output three separate files: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference. Use a single consistent class-naming convention (BEM) throughout — never mix conventions. Invent a fictional brand name, product, and all copy; never use the real Athletics brand name, logo, trademarks, or product names anywhere in the page.

## 2. Strict Architecture Rules
- **CSS-First, Zero Inline CSS:** All styling lives in `style.css`. Forbid `style="..."` attributes. Target everything via class/ID selectors. Keep HTML semantic and styling-agnostic.
- **CSS Variables & Tokens:** Store all visual tokens in `:root` (and theme classes) using `var(--...)`. Required tokens:
  - Colors: `--color-obsidian: #000000`, `--color-charcoal: #1d1d1d`, `--color-paper-white: #ffffff`, `--color-ash: #d6d5d0`, plus `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`.
  - Contrast pairing: light bg → dark text, dark bg → light text, enforced for every theme.
  - Light-mode background must not default to pure white; where white/near-white is needed use `#fefefe`.
  - Radius/shadows: `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (shadows may be defined but must remain unused per theme rules).
  - Spacing/transitions: `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`.
  - Elevation/stacking: `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.
- **Mandatory Dark Mode:** Provide dark tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and/or `.dark`. Theme variables switch seamlessly without HTML restructuring. Persist user choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Include a visible toggle with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label`.
- **Flexbox & Mobile-First:** Use `display: flex` for layouts. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless explicitly justified. Mobile-responsive out of the box (rows → columns on small viewports). No horizontal scrolling.
- **Tailwind Integration:** Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS via `@layer`/`@apply`). Utilities must map to CSS variables or reusable classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).
- **Google Fonts & Icons (Mandatory):** Use Google Fonts for text and Google Material Symbols/Icons. Forbid raw inline SVGs or local icon files. Bind text font to `--font-base`. Note: Feature Deck and Söhne are not on Google Fonts; substitute with Google Fonts equivalents (e.g., Fraunces or Playfair Display for the serif display, Inter for the grotesque) while preserving the specified weights, sizes, tracking, and line-heights. Use `@import`/`<link>` tags.

## 3. Theme Tokens (Athletics)
- Canvas: `--color-obsidian: #000000` (base page bg, hero, footer).
- Elevated: `--color-charcoal: #1d1d1d` (section bands, cards, inputs).
- Text: `--color-paper-white: #ffffff` (all readable text).
- Border/divider: `--color-ash: #d6d5d0` (hairlines only; never use for text).
- Accent: none. Primary action: neutral monochrome button treatment.
- Typography:
  - Display serif (substitute Google Font): weight 300, sizes 72/82/116px, line-height 1.05–1.10, letter-spacing -0.009em (82px) / -0.018em (116px). Display-only at 72px+.
  - Grotesque (substitute Google Font, e.g., Inter): weights 300/400, sizes 16/17/22px, line-height 1.30–1.50.
  - Type scale tokens: `--text-body-sm` (16px/1.5), `--text-subheading` (22px/1.3), `--text-heading` (72px/1.1/-0.65px), `--text-heading-lg` (82px/1.05/-0.74px), `--text-display` (116px/1.05/-2.09px).
- Spacing: base 8px; scale 16/24/32/48/64/128/144px. Section gaps 128–144px. Card padding 24px. Element gap 24–32px.
- Radius: tags/buttons 9999px; cards 8px.
- Layout: page max-width 1440px; full-bleed dark; no visible container.
- Surfaces: flat only — no shadows, no gradients, no glows, no elevation. Separation via flat color shifts and hairline borders.
- Chromatic color: forbidden in UI. Color only inside brand mark / editorial photography.

## 4. Component Requirements
Enforce all states via CSS classes:
- **Buttons (pill):** default flex `align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem`, min 44×44px touch target; hover brightness/shadow + pointer; focus ring via CSS vars; active `transform: scale(0.97)`; loading disables + CSS spinner without dimension change; disabled opacity 0.5 + greyscale + not-allowed; success/error via `--text-success`/`--text-error`.
- **Cards:** flex layout, subtle borders/elevation via `--bg-secondary` + vars; hover elevation/`translateY(-2px)`; focus-within border highlight; loading skeleton shimmer; empty state with Google Icon + guidance text.
- **Forms/Inputs:** states empty/focused/filled/valid/invalid/disabled/readonly; flex wrapper (label + input + error container); bottom-border-only 1px `#d6d5d0` on dark; white placeholder/text; no box/fill.
- **Modal/Popup:** opening/open/loading/success-error/closing animated via CSS; centered flex container; backdrop; Google Icon close; focus trapping; close via Esc/overlay.
- **Top Nav:** transparent/black, no border/shadow. Wordmark left (16px grotesque 400 white). Right-aligned links (Work, About, Approach, Careers, Contact) 16px grotesque 400 white, 16px column gap. No bg fill/border/underline.
- **Hero:** centered stack on `#000000`. Large editorial mark (letterform 'A' filled with a red/magenta-tinted editorial photo) above 116px display serif 300 white, letter-spacing -0.018em. Mark is the only chromatic color.
- **Section Opener (two-column):** `#1d1d1d` bg. Left ~60%: small uppercase label (16px grotesque 400 white) above 72px display serif 300 white (-0.65px). Right ~35%: body 17px grotesque 400 white, max-width 480px, line-height 1.5. 128–144px vertical padding.
- **Specialty Tag (pill):** 9999px radius, white bg, black text 16px grotesque 400, padding 8px 16px, no border/shadow.
- **Service Index List:** stacked service names 82px display serif 300 white (-0.74px), line-height 1.05. Single uppercase letter A/B/C/D 16px grotesque 400 white flush-left per row. No dividers/bullets.
- **Hairline Divider:** 1px solid `#d6d5d0`.
- **Pill Button:** 9999px radius, white bg, black text 16px grotesque 400, padding 12px 24px, no border/shadow. No color-change hover — keep monochrome flat.

## 5. Landing Page Sections
Build these sections in order: Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links. Use fictional copy. Ensure responsive, accessible, with ARIA roles/labels, semantic HTML5, keyboard operability, `aria-live` for dynamic feedback, and `prefers-reduced-motion` respect.

## 6. UX & Micro-Interactions
- Responsive by default; fluid sizing; no horizontal overflow.
- CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast in both modes; never rely on color alone; semantic HTML; ARIA on custom widgets; logical focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions.
- Mandatory visual feedback on every click/hover/submission.
- Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

## 7. Deliverables
- Files: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`.
- Naming: BEM consistently.
- No lorem-ipsum-only where real copy is supplied; placeholders only where content genuinely unspecified.
- Dark mode toggle persisted via `localStorage`.

## 8. Output
Output only the finished prompt content above as your response to the coding AI — no preamble, no closing commentary. Mirror numbered headers and bolded sub-rules. If any request conflicts with a mandatory rule, keep the rule and add a one-line explicit exception clause. All copy must be in English. Translate any non-English guidance to English. Keep CSS variable names, class names, file names in English/ASCII. Do not write actual HTML/CSS/JS code yourself.
